caption: Each box is the set of states the machine may be in after that many symbols of 0110, not a single state. The guess adds q1 on the first 1, and after the last 0 the set contains q3, so the string is accepted.

spec.title: Trace of the set of states on 0110
spec.aria: Five boxes in a row for input 0110: the active set is q0, then q0 again after 0, then q0 and q1 after the first 1, then q0 q1 q2, and finally q0 q2 q3 which holds the final state q3.
